summary: Today's focus is on maintaining optimal air circulation and carefully monitoring humidity levels, while ensuring proper hydration without overdoing it.

tasks.action: Gently insert finger 2 inches into soil to assess moisture level; if topsoil is dry, prepare for afternoon watering.
Open a nearby window for at least 45 minutes to enhance airflow and prevent humidity from stagnating around foliage.
Visually inspect all leaves and stems for any signs of condensation or lingering moisture, especially in crevices.
If morning check indicated dry soil, provide 175ml of room-temperature filtered water directly to the soil base, avoiding the leaves.
Check the sensor for current humidity readings again to confirm the rising trend has stabilized or decreased, adjusting ventilation if necessary.
Rotate the pot 1/4 turn clockwise to ensure even light exposure to all sides of the foliage.
Ensure room temperature is maintained between 20-22°C for optimal rest; close windows if outdoor temperatures are dropping significantly.
Gently aerate the top inch of soil using a small stick or chopstick to encourage gas exchange and prevent compaction.
Perform a final visual check for any pests or unusual leaf appearances before the night.
